label: up the road from the S5 seam past the bridgehead stalls, between the two ox carts and on past the thatched hut
why: legs are [heading, seconds] at 2.2 m/s; the painted crowd stands round the basket north of the line and S5's cart team south of it; past the rider the walk dips south of the second cart's tail and its crouching man, then back north between the second cart's oxen and the thatched hut, the road's narrowest place (D 4.6-7)

label: over the little humped bridge onto the courier post's forecourt
why: the bridge rises over the planked ditch from the road to the raised forecourt (0.6 m); the soldier hugging his knee and the furled banner's pole stand at its north end, the walk passes between them

label: through the courier post's gate into the yard
why: the gate's west leaf stands open inward; the white horse lies in the yard further north

label: the planked ditch bank stops you west of the bridge
why: the forecourt's planked face (0.85 m) can't be stepped up; the bridge is the way in

label: onto the temple gate hall's plinth before its shut door
up the side open ground past the porter's line, the fence's end and the woman with her child, to the shop
why: the pig herd (real-size bodies) stands west of this line at X 14.5-16.3, D 21.7-22.9, as painted; the walk passes 0.65 m east of the rail fence's end and 0.8 m west of the woman, to the shop's front

label: into the eating house's open front from the south
why: between the two small tables and past the bench running back from the front

label: south edge: the silk's bottom edge stops you west of the big hall
east edge: the inner seam (u 12600) stops you on the road
north edge: the silk's top edge stops you north of the willows
west edge (alone): the S5 seam stops you at the bridgehead
